(ns build
  (:require [clojure.tools.build.api :as b]))

(def class-dir "target/classes")
(def uber-file "target/kvhttp-standalone.jar")
(def basis (delay (b/create-basis {:project "deps.edn"})))

(defn clean [_]
  (b/delete {:path "target"}))

(defn uber [_]
  (clean nil)
  (b/copy-dir {:src-dirs ["src"] :target-dir class-dir})
  (b/compile-clj {:basis @basis
                  :ns-compile '[kvhttp.main]
                  :class-dir class-dir
                  :compiler-options {:direct-linking true}})
  (b/uber {:class-dir class-dir
           :uber-file uber-file
           :basis @basis
           :main 'kvhttp.main}))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds the release uberjar and installs the ./app launcher.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

clojure -T:build uber

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
exec java -XX:+UseParallelGC -jar "$DIR/target/kvhttp-standalone.jar" "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app

(ns kvhttp.handler
  "Ring handler implementing the kvhttp routes."
  (:require [clojure.data.json :as json]
            [kvhttp.store :as store])
  (:import (java.io ByteArrayInputStream InputStream)))

(set! *warn-on-reflection* true)

(def ^:private key-pattern #"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}")

(def ^:private empty-bytes (byte-array 0))

(defn valid-key?
  "True if `s` is a syntactically valid key."
  [s]
  (boolean (re-matches key-pattern s)))

(defn- response
  ([status] (response status nil))
  ([status body] {:status status :headers {} :body body}))

(defn- bytes-response [^bytes value]
  {:status 200
   :headers {"Content-Type" "application/octet-stream"
             "Content-Length" (str (alength value))}
   :body (ByteArrayInputStream. value)})

(defn- read-body ^bytes [{:keys [body]}]
  (if body
    (.readAllBytes ^InputStream body)
    empty-bytes))

(defn- method-not-allowed [allowed]
  (assoc-in (response 405) [:headers "Allow"] allowed))

(defn- health [{:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    {:status 200 :headers {"Content-Type" "text/plain"} :body "ok"}
    (method-not-allowed "GET")))

(defn- list-keys [kv {:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    {:status 200
     :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
     :body (json/write-str (store/all-keys kv))}
    (method-not-allowed "GET")))

(defn- item [kv k {:keys [request-method] :as req}]
  (cond
    (not (valid-key? k))
    (response 400)

    (= :get request-method)
    (if-let [value (store/fetch kv k)]
      (bytes-response value)
      (response 404))

    (= :put request-method)
    (case (store/put! kv k (read-body req))
      :created (response 201)
      :replaced (response 200))

    (= :delete request-method)
    (response (if (store/delete! kv k) 204 404))

    :else
    (method-not-allowed "GET, PUT, DELETE")))

(def ^:private item-prefix "/kv/")

(defn make-handler
  "Returns a Ring handler serving the routes over the store `kv`."
  [kv]
  (fn [{:keys [^String uri] :as req}]
    (cond
      (= "/health" uri) (health req)
      (= "/kv" uri) (list-keys kv req)
      (.startsWith uri item-prefix) (item kv (subs uri (count item-prefix)) req)
      :else (response 404))))

(ns kvhttp.main
  "Entry point: `app <port>` serves the key-value API on 127.0.0.1."
  (:require [kvhttp.handler :as handler]
            [kvhttp.store :as store]
            [org.httpkit.server :as http])
  (:gen-class))

(def ^:private max-body-bytes
  "Values may be up to 1 MiB; leave headroom for the transport."
  (* 8 1024 1024))

(defn start!
  "Starts the server on `port` and returns the http-kit server instance."
  [port]
  (http/run-server (handler/make-handler (store/create))
                   {:ip "127.0.0.1"
                    :port port
                    :thread 64
                    :max-body max-body-bytes
                    :legacy-return-value? false}))

(defn- usage! []
  (binding [*out* *err*]
    (println "usage: app <port>"))
  (System/exit 2))

(defn -main [& args]
  (if-let [port (some-> (first args) parse-long)]
    (do (start! port)
        @(promise))
    (usage!)))

(ns kvhttp.store
  "In-memory key-value store backed by an atom holding a sorted map.")

(defn create
  "Returns a new, empty store."
  []
  (atom (sorted-map)))

(defn put!
  "Stores `value` under `k`. Returns `:created` if the key was new,
  `:replaced` otherwise."
  [store k value]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store assoc k value)]
    (if (contains? old k) :replaced :created)))

(defn fetch
  "Returns the value stored under `k`, or nil."
  [store k]
  (get @store k))

(defn delete!
  "Removes `k`. Returns true if it was present."
  [store k]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store dissoc k)]
    (contains? old k)))

(defn all-keys
  "Returns every key, sorted ascending."
  [store]
  (vec (keys @store)))

(ns kvhttp.handler-test
  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is testing]]
            [kvhttp.handler :as handler]
            [kvhttp.store :as store])
  (:import (java.io ByteArrayInputStream InputStream)))

(defn- req
  ([method uri] (req method uri nil))
  ([method uri ^String body]
   {:request-method method
    :uri uri
    :body (some-> body .getBytes ByteArrayInputStream.)}))

(defn- body-str [{:keys [body]}]
  (if (instance? InputStream body)
    (String. (.readAllBytes ^InputStream body))
    body))

(deftest routes
  (let [h (handler/make-handler (store/create))]
    (testing "health"
      (is (= "ok" (body-str (h (req :get "/health")))))
      (is (= 405 (:status (h (req :post "/health"))))))
    (testing "crud"
      (is (= 201 (:status (h (req :put "/kv/a" "hello")))))
      (is (= 200 (:status (h (req :put "/kv/a" "world")))))
      (is (= "world" (body-str (h (req :get "/kv/a")))))
      (is (= 204 (:status (h (req :delete "/kv/a")))))
      (is (= 404 (:status (h (req :delete "/kv/a")))))
      (is (= 404 (:status (h (req :get "/kv/a"))))))
    (testing "listing"
      (h (req :put "/kv/b" "2"))
      (h (req :put "/kv/a" "1"))
      (is (= "[\"a\",\"b\"]" (:body (h (req :get "/kv"))))))
    (testing "errors"
      (is (= 400 (:status (h (req :get "/kv/bad.key")))))
      (is (= 400 (:status (h (req :get "/kv/")))))
      (is (= 400 (:status (h (req :get "/kv/a/b")))))
      (is (= 400 (:status (h (req :get (str "/kv/" (apply str (repeat 65 "x"))))))))
      (is (= 405 (:status (h (req :patch "/kv/a")))))
      (is (= 405 (:status (h (req :post "/kv")))))
      (is (= 404 (:status (h (req :get "/nope"))))))))
